# Progress

Show exact task completion or an explicitly indeterminate operation.

## Usage

### Known progress

Expose the known amount completed against an explicit maximum.

<ComponentExample component="progress" scenario="determinate" title="Known progress" description="Expose the known amount completed against an explicit maximum." :index="0" />

### Unknown progress

Represent work whose completed amount is not yet known.

<ComponentExample component="progress" scenario="indeterminate" title="Unknown progress" description="Represent work whose completed amount is not yet known." :index="1" />

### Complete

Expose the terminal state when the current value reaches the maximum.

<ComponentExample component="progress" scenario="complete" title="Complete" description="Expose the terminal state when the current value reaches the maximum." :index="2" />

### Exact decimal

Enter 0.1 as decimal text and preserve it without binary floating-point coercion.

<ComponentExample component="progress" scenario="exact-decimal" title="Exact decimal" description="Enter 0.1 as decimal text and preserve it without binary floating-point coercion." :index="3" />

## Progress-motion example

Determinate Progress exposes `--sectile-progress-percentage` on its indicator. Interpolate value changes briefly and reserve a separate looping motion for indeterminate work.

```css
[data-scope='progress'][data-part='indicator'] {
  inline-size: var(--sectile-progress-percentage, 0%);
  transition: inline-size 180ms linear;
}

[data-scope='progress'][data-part='indicator'][data-status='indeterminate'] {
  inline-size: 35%;
  animation: progress-indeterminate 1.1s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}

@keyframes progress-indeterminate {
  from { transform: translateX(-15%); }
  to { transform: translateX(185%); }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  [data-scope='progress'][data-part='indicator'] {
    animation: none;
    transition: none;
  }
}
```

See [Progress API](/api/components/progress) for props, events, slots, public types, part selectors, and keyboard behavior.

## Accessibility

The named progress bar exposes zero and its maximum, omitting the current value and value text while progress is indeterminate.
